name: Abell S1077 (Hubble)
blurb: Abell S1077, a galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: abells1077-hubble
story: A vast gathering of galaxies held together by its own gravity, so massive that it bends the light of galaxies far behind it. The thin streaks that look like scratches on a lens are those distant galaxies, stretched by the cluster's pull.

claims.text: Abell S1077 is a galaxy cluster
Galaxy clusters are held together by their gravity
The cluster's mass bends light passing through it
Stretched streaks in the field are distant galaxies distorted by the cluster
Program 11591 targets ABELL-S1077 as one of its lensing clusters (AS1077 used as label)
